strategy.summary: The todo app (static public/app.js served by server.js, all state in memory in the page) lets users tick todos to complete them, filter by All/Active/Completed and clear completed todos. Tests must prove the strike-through and "items left" count follow the checkbox, each filter shows exactly the right todos and is aria-pressed, and "Clear completed" is shown only while something is completed and removes all completed todos.
inScope: Completing/uncompleting todos via the checkbox (strike-through, items-left count)
All / Active / Completed filters and their pressed state
Visibility and behaviour of the Clear completed button
outOfScope: Adding todos (covered by tests/add-todo.spec.js, TODO-7 doesn't change it)
Persistence across reloads (the app keeps todos in memory only; ticket doesn't ask for it)
assumptions: The real app runs: Playwright's existing webServer starts `node server.js` on port 4173; nothing is faked (there is no backend API, state lives in the page).
Each test gets a fresh page, so todos never leak between tests; titles are still unique per test for readability.
'Struck through' is asserted as computed text-decoration-line: line-through on the todo's title text (styles.css), the user-visible outcome; the 'completed' class itself is not asserted.
Todos are created through the UI the same way tests/add-todo.spec.js does (label 'What needs doing?' + Add button).
openQuestions: Should the selected filter survive a reload (e.g. via URL hash)? The app doesn't do this and the ticket doesn't ask; not tested.

risks.description: Items-left count not updated or wrong pluralisation after toggling
risks.mitigation: TC1/TC2 assert exact count text before and after tick and untick

risks.description: Filters show the wrong set or the pressed state doesn't follow the selection
risks.mitigation: TC3-TC5 assert exact list contents and aria-pressed on all three buttons

risks.description: Clear completed removes active todos or only one completed todo, or stays visible
risks.mitigation: TC7 uses two completed and one active todo and asserts the exact remaining list and hidden button; TC6 asserts it's hidden when nothing is completed

risks.description: A todo completed while the Active filter is on stays visible

acceptanceCriteria.text: Ticking a todo's checkbox marks it completed: its title is struck through and the 'items left' count drops by one; unticking reverses both.
The Active filter shows only non-completed todos, Completed only completed ones, All every todo; the selected filter button is aria-pressed=true and the others false.
'Clear completed' is visible only while at least one todo is completed, and clicking it removes every completed todo and no active one.

testCases.title: ticking a todo strikes it through and decrements items left
steps: Check '2 items left' and 'Walk dog' not struck through
testCases.expected: 'Walk dog' checkbox checked, its title has text-decoration-line line-through, 'Pay rent' does not, count reads '1 item left'

testCases.title: unticking a completed todo removes the strike-through and restores items left
testCases.expected: Checkbox unchecked, title text-decoration-line none, count reads '2 items left'

testCases.title: Active filter shows only todos that are not completed and is pressed
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Walk dog', 'Water plants']; Active aria-pressed true, All and Completed false
testCases.rationale: Active filter contents and pressed state

testCases.title: Completed filter shows only completed todos and is pressed
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Pay rent']; Completed pressed, All and Active not
testCases.rationale: Completed filter contents and pressed state

testCases.title: All filter shows every todo again and is pressed
testCases.expected: List is exactly all three titles in added order; All pressed, Active and Completed not
testCases.rationale: Returning to All restores the full list

testCases.title: Clear completed is hidden while no todo is completed
steps: Add 'Walk dog' and confirm it is listed
testCases.expected: Clear completed hidden with only active todos, visible once one is ticked, hidden again after unticking
testCases.rationale: Refusal side: button must not be offered when there's nothing to clear

testCases.title: Clear completed removes every completed todo and keeps active ones
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Pay rent'], count '1 item left', Clear completed hidden
testCases.rationale: Proves all (not just one) completed todos are removed and active ones survive

testCases.title: completing a todo while the Active filter is selected removes it from the view
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Pay rent'], Active still pressed, count '1 item left'
testCases.rationale: Filter must re-evaluate on state change, not only on filter click

strategy.environmentNotes: Playwright webServer runs `node server.js` on http://localhost:4173 (existing config); chromium browser required. No env vars or seed data.
